turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Owen's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me, and he found out on his phone in the middle of class. I want it withdrawn, Hale, and I want to know who decided it.
Okay. You asked for this meeting, so go ahead. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about the weather. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
What do you do for fun?
I'm waiting, Hale. I have until 4:40, and I'd like to spend it on Owen's zero.
